ModMetaData.name: Power Grid Manager
ModMetaData.author: ArliT1-F
ModMetaData.description:
Monitor colony power networks, generation, consumption, storage and history from a centralised dashboard. Power Grid Manager observes RimWorld's own power simulation and never replaces or alters it.
Open the Power tab to see map-wide totals, per-network detail, a searchable table of every powered building, and recorded charts of generation, consumption, net balance, battery charge and load. All figures are labelled as measured, configured or estimated.
